children: BKV completed a $575 million offering of 1.625% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 and entered into related capped call transactions to manage potential dilution. Net proceeds were about $554.7 million, including $64.7 million spent on capped calls and $35.0 million used to repurchase 1,452,282 shares at $24.10. The notes, governed by an Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, mature October 15, 2031, pay 1.625% semi-annually, and are initially convertible at approximately $31.93 per share. The capped calls, with a $48.20 cap price, are designed to reduce dilution and/or offset cash payments upon conversion.

: Raise capital, refinance debt, and fund capex

: Capped call confirmations related to 2031 convertible notes
: Option Counterparties (affiliates of initial purchasers and other financial institutions)
: Reduce dilution and offset cash on conversion
